summary: The ordinary-growth side is available from Add-my-Pet (raw age–length/age–weight series per species, including zebrafish). The regeneration side is not in any repository found: Dryad, Zenodo, DataCite and BioImage Archive searches for regenerate length vs time since amputation (fin, limb, tail, planarian) returned either nothing or molecular/physiological datasets without outgrowth measurements. Regeneration growth curves exist only in paper figures and would have to be digitised.
next_step: Digitise regenerate-length time courses from classic and modern papers (e.g., zebrafish caudal fin, axolotl limb, lizard tail) into one table with time since amputation and temperature; pair with AmP age–length series for the same species, then pre-register the curve-shape comparison.
obstacles_confirmed: Matched regeneration and zero-origin ontogeny data are rare.
Regeneration lengths are scattered across papers and start after a latent period that is poorly sampled.
